title: Fixed conormal powers, tensor-pullback pieces and representative maps
statement: For a closed immersion i : Z → X [def-weil-closed-immersion], put I = ker(i) [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Define power n to be the actual iterated ideal-module product I^n [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], with its inclusion into O_X; piece n is its tensor pullback i^*(I^n) [def-pc-module-pullback]. The representative is the chosen pullback-adjunction unit evaluated on a section. A homogeneousClass is this representative followed by a specified degree inclusion into an algebra. quotientStalk is the canonical isomorphism O_{X,i(z)}/ker(i_z) → O_{Z,z}. These six definitions are relocated verbatim from the parent module and publicly re-exported there.

proof.text: Use the existing explicit ideal powers, tensor pullback and its fixed adjunction unit. Define homogeneousClass by composition. The closed immersion gives a surjective local-ring map, whose quotient-kernel equivalence is quotientStalk.
